bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR flipped bullish, 200-day overhead
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，上方为 200 日均线

read.en: Applied Materials rose 5.1% on Oct 28 to $416.00, trading between $401.44 and $421.83. It is above the falling 5-day ($390.5) and 10-day ($401.9) averages and below the rising 200-day ($443.5) and the falling 30-day ($461.6) and 100-day ($511.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($372.80), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月28日上涨 5.1%，收于 $416.00，盘中区间 $401.44–421.83。股价位于下行的 5 日（$390.5）和 10 日均线（$401.9）上方，低于上行的 200 日均线（$443.5）以及下行的 30 日（$461.6）和 100 日均线（$511.0）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$372.80），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close cleared $398–414 (Oct 27 high, 10-day, Oct 16 low, Oct 21 high), now support, and turned the SAR bullish. Resistance is $421.8–427.7 (Oct 28 and Oct 19 highs), then $434.6 (Oct 15 high) and $443.5 (200-day). Support is $407.3–414, then $399–402 (10-day, Oct 28 low) and $390.5 (5-day). A close above $427.7 would target $435–443; below $407, $399–402.

s.en: Oct 16 low $407.3; Oct 21 high $414, now support
